glosses: resistent (not affected or overcome by negative circumstances)

examples.text: O celeiro era pequeno, mas resistente.
examples.en: The barn was small, but it was strong.

examples.text: Eu era a criança mais resistente do bairro.
examples.en: I was the toughest kid in the neighborhood.

examples.text: As pessoas às vezes são tão resistentes a mudanças.
examples.en: People are sometimes resistant to change.
